book.title: Lijambu la Amboni ngati ejuandiki Matei

content: Yesu andamisa mundu
Yesu ejahuluka ku kitombi, nsambi nkolongu wa bandu watenda kumpwata.
Mundu jumu jojuleliki anzendila, anzinamia nukupwaga, “Bambu, ana gupai guwesa kunyambisa.”
Yesu jwanyosha kuboku kwaki angusa mundu jojuleliki jola nukumpwagi, “Mbala gunyambisika.” Apalapa mundu jola jatenda kulama.
Ndipala Yesu ampwagila mundu jola, “Jowania, wampwagi mundu jokapi, ila gujenda ukulilangia kwaka nngolu nkolongu na ukapia litambiku lejalagalakiya Musa, kwaalangi bandu gulamiki.”
Kuhobale kwaka nkolongu jumu juku Loma
Yesu pajabia jujingii ku Kapelinaumu, nkolongu jumu jwa alonda juku Loma anzendila, nukunndoba anzangatia,
ampwagila, “Bambu, mtumi wangu jugoni kunyumba, nngonzu jukulela nhyega kabee julwala ngamaa.”
Yesu ampwagila, “Niijenda kundamisa.”
Lakini nkolongu jola ampwagila, “Bambu, nepani ngase kupalika wehapa gujingila mu nyumba jango. Lakini pwaga lilobi pee, nu ntumi wangu jwiitenda kulama.”

“Ndaba, hata ngama nepani anongo akolongu bangi kabee mi na alonda banaalongo. Nunndagalaki ajojo, ‘Jenda’ najombi jutenda kujenda, nunndagalaki jongi, ‘Hikaa’ najombi jutenda kuhika. Kabee ana nunndagalaki ntumwa wangu, ‘Henga ase’ najombi jutenda kuhenga.”
Yesu ejajoana malobi gala, jatenda kusanga, jaapwagila bandu babumpwatiki, “Numpwaagi sakaka, ngase nhwaiki kumbona mundu jokapi pa Izilaeli pani jojuhobale ngati ajo.
Numpwaagi sakaka, bandu bingi bihika kuhuma ku kolipita lioba nu kolihobe lioba, nabombi biitama pa tipati gakula posu pamu na Ibulahimu na Isaka na Yakobu mu Ukolongu ukunani kwaka Sapanga.
Lakini bandu baapalika kuba mu ubambu ukolongu waka Sapanga, mitibaalekala kunza, kolubii lwii, kokuje biibiya alela nukupola minu.”
Ndipala Yesu ampwagila nkolongu jola, “Jenda kunyumba na gaguhobali haga giitenda kuhengeka.” Nu ntumi jola jatenda kulama muda agolagola.
Yesu jalamisa bandu bingi
Yesu ejajingala mu nyumba jaka Petili, jaakolila akowanu baka Petili agoni pikitanda abii na homa.
Ndienu, Yesu angusa nyongoo jola kuboku, na homa jela jatenda kukotoka, jatumbuliya kuntumaki Yesu.
Ekwabiya pakamii, bandu bundetila Yesu bandu bingi bababii niilombu, Yesu jaaboa ilombu sukupwaga pee lilobi, ndi jaalamisa bandu boka bababi agonzu boti.
Jahenga hela ili gatimia gajaapwaga mlota jwaka Sapanga Isaya, “Jombi mweni jujukwi mang'aliku gitu kabee jutotwi magonzu gitu.”
Eapalika kuba banafunzi baka Yesu
Yesu ejugubona nsambi wa bandu gunhyongaliti, jaapwagila banafunzi baki ajenda kwii ju nhanga.
Mmbola jumu jwa Malagalaki anzendila Yesu, ampwagila, “Mmbola, nepani nagupwata kwokapi kola kowijenda.”
Yesu jajibua, “Mabwea gabii na mapoli gabu, ni ijuni yukunani ibii ni miui jabu, lakini mwana waka Mundu nga na pandu puku pomulalela.”
Mbolee waki jumu ampwagila, “Bambu, nyetakaliya nyenda kunyumba nakaataga atati bangu.”
Lakini Yesu ampwagila, “Mbwata! Waaleka baawii baataga baawii ajabu.”
Yesu jagalakali majeba
Yesu pajajingala munhwatu banafunzi baki batenda kumpwata.
Apalapa, gapitila majeba makolongu munhanga na masi gatumbuliya kuguyekale nhwatu. Lakini Yesu jabiya jugosi lugonu.
Banafunzi baki bunzendila, bunzumua nukupwaaga, “Bambu, utuokuaje tutenda kuwa!”
Lakini Yesu jwaapwagila, “Mwabandu bini lihobale lisokopi mwanganya, ndaba jaki ntenda kujogopa?” Ndienu, jajumuka jagalakaliya majeba makolongu gala nu nhanga gola gwatuli nuu.
Banafunzi baki basangi nukupwaga, “Jonioju we mundu bole? Hata unhwai na majeba gatenda kunzoanela!”
Yesu jaalamisa bandu abeli bini ilombu
Yesu ejahika kwii ju nhanga, munndema wa Agadala, jwaketangana na bandu abeli baabii ni ilombu bakahumila kutenge. Bandu haba babiya ajogoo ngamaa, nga mundu jojalenga kupeta indela jela.
Apalapa batenda kujamalii, “Gupala kike kwito, wehapa wa Mwana waka Sapanga? Guhikiki pamba kutung'alisa kabula ji lisoba litu kuhika?”
Pambipi na pandu pehapa kwabii na magolobi gingi gakakula.
Ilombu yela yundoba Yesu, “Anautubenga, nambanga utujetakiya tugajingala magolobi galaga.”
Jaapwagila, “Hena mmbokaniya.” Ndienu yaapiita bandu bala, nu kujingii mwamagolobi, na magolobi ge gatilila pilikemba luku nhanga nukujingi mu nhanga, na goti gakuwa mmasi.
Alimu ba magolobi bala batilila ku musi. Hoku baalandila bandu kila sindu sesapitila na gagaapitila bandu bababii ni ilombu.
Bandu boti ba musi we gola bunzendila Yesu, pabumbona bundoba juboka mu nndema wabu.
